# ghost/arxiv

Search public arXiv papers and read native metadata and abstracts without downloads or account

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/arxiv
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/arxiv open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/arxiv prepare_search --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/arxiv search --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/arxiv read_paper --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the anonymous arXiv dashboard without downloads or favourites
- `prepare_search`: Open the native public paper search field
- `search`: Submit a public arXiv paper search and read its first exposed paper
- `read_paper`: Read the first exposed paper metadata and native abstract text
